vision: A simple, fast, and attractive Flutter mobile shopping app that lets customers browse our beauty products and add them to a cart, giving us a low-cost first version to validate that customers will shop with us on mobile before we invest in a fuller ecommerce platform.
target_users: Beauty shoppers aged 18-40 who mainly shop on their smartphones and want to discover and compare skincare, makeup, haircare and fragrance products quickly
Existing customers of our store and social channels who want an easier way to see the full catalogue and reorder favorites
Gift buyers looking for beauty products who need clear photos, prices and descriptions to decide fast
Internal store staff (non-technical) who will update product information and monitor the app through a simple admin process
business_goals: Launch a working MVP on iOS and Android from a single Flutter codebase within roughly 8-12 weeks
Validate mobile demand: get at least 1,000 app installs and 100 users adding items to the cart within the first 3 months
Achieve a cart-add rate of at least 15% of product detail views
Create a foundation that can later support checkout, payments, accounts and promotions without a rebuild
Keep initial build and running costs low by limiting scope to product browsing and cart
Collect basic usage insights (most viewed products, most carted products) to guide merchandising and the next release
key_features: Product catalogue browse: scrollable product list/grid with product image, name, brand, and price
Product categories (e.g., Skincare, Makeup, Haircare, Fragrance, Body) for easy navigation
Product search by name or brand, with simple category filtering
Product detail page: multiple images, description, ingredients, size/variant (e.g., shade or volume), price, and stock status
Shopping cart: add to cart, remove items, change quantity, see line totals and cart subtotal
Cart persistence so items remain after the app is closed and reopened
Product data loaded from a backend/API or managed data source so the team can update products without releasing a new app version
Basic loading, empty, and error states (e.g., empty cart, no search results, no internet connection)
Basic analytics tracking of screen views, product views, and add-to-cart events
Clean, brand-aligned visual design with our logo, colors, and mobile-friendly layout
constraints: Scope limited to product browse and cart for the MVP; real checkout and payment processing are out of scope for this release
Must be built with Flutter and run on both iOS and Android
Budget and timeline are limited: MVP must be delivered in about 8-12 weeks with a small team
No user accounts or login required in the MVP; cart is stored on the device
Initial catalogue of roughly 50-150 products, with product images and descriptions supplied by the business
Single currency and single market at launch, English language only
Must comply with basic app store policies and privacy requirements, including a privacy policy and disclosure of analytics use
Product images must be optimized so browsing feels fast on average mobile connections
We are not technical, so the solution should be simple to maintain and the admin/product update process easy to use
open_questions: Where will the product data come from: an existing ecommerce platform (e.g., Shopify) or a new simple backend?
Will the cart end in a 'checkout' button that redirects to our website, collects an order by email/WhatsApp, or is it just a placeholder in the MVP?
Which market and currency will we launch in first, and do we need tax or shipping estimates displayed in the cart?
Do we need product variants such as shades and sizes with separate stock levels and prices in the MVP?
Do we want wishlists, reviews and ratings, or promo codes in a later phase, and how should they be prioritized?
Should we add user accounts and order history in the next release, and is social login desired?
What is the final brand identity (logo, color palette, fonts) and who will supply product photography?
Will we need push notifications for promotions or abandoned carts after the MVP?
Which analytics tool should we use, and what consent approach do we need for our customers' regions?
Who on our team will manage product updates day to day, and what tools are they comfortable with?
What is the exact launch date and final budget ceiling for the MVP?
